metadata.title: AI Sovereignty Lab v0.4 Source Audit, Sprint 1
metadata.purpose: Verify exact claims, identify overreach and define required dataset corrections before the interactive MVP.

material_findings: Local cloud-region presence must remain classified separately from domestic ownership and full sovereignty.
Azure Israel Central is verified as supporting Availability Zones, but this source does not support an exact zone count.
Google Cloud documentation supports three Tel Aviv zones and limited GPU availability, but not frontier-scale local training capacity.
AI21 product pages support Jamba and self-hosting, but a separate source is required for precise corporate ownership classification.
The current Government Decision 4255 URL did not resolve through the audit process and needs a stable official replacement or archived copy.

exact_supported_claims: The AWS Israel, Tel Aviv Region is open.
The region consists of three Availability Zones.
AWS states that data can be stored in Israel.
AWS plans to invest up to ILS 26.6 billion in the region from 2023 through 2037.
limitations: The page does not establish domestic Israeli ownership or full legal and supply-chain sovereignty.
The investment figure is a company plan and must not be presented as completed expenditure.
audits.required_dataset_action: Keep foreign_owned_locally_hosted. Preserve three-zone metric. Label the investment as planned maximum through 2037.

exact_supported_claims: The Google Cloud region in Tel Aviv is open.
The region identifier is me-west1.
Google Cloud was selected to provide cloud services to Israeli government ministries.
limitations: The announcement does not establish national ownership or independence from Google's control plane and global supply chain.
audits.required_dataset_action: No material correction. Retain foreign_owned_locally_hosted classification.

exact_supported_claims: The Tel Aviv region includes me-west1-a, me-west1-b and me-west1-c.
The documentation lists GPU-capable machine availability in the region, including A2 and T4 options in selected zones.
unsupported_or_overextended_claims: The source does not establish frontier-scale local training capacity.
The source does not establish availability of the latest NVIDIA accelerator generations in Israel.
audits.required_dataset_action: Retain three zones and GPU-capable wording. Add an explicit limitation that the evidence does not prove frontier-scale local compute.

exact_supported_claims: Israel Central is listed among Azure regions supporting Availability Zones.
unsupported_or_overextended_claims: This source does not state an exact number of zones for Israel Central.
This source does not establish specific frontier AI accelerator availability in the region.
audits.required_dataset_action: Keep Availability Zone support. Do not add a three-zone metric without a more specific Microsoft source.

audits.publisher: Government Procurement Administration, Government of Israel
exact_supported_claims: Nimbus is a multi-year, large-scale government project.
AWS and Google were selected to provide public cloud services to the Government of Israel.
The official description includes five layers: public cloud, cloud policy and CCoE, migration and integration, monitoring and FinOps, and a third-party cloud marketplace.
limitations: Government procurement and governance do not transfer ownership of the hyperscaler technology stack to Israel.
audits.required_dataset_action: No material correction. Use Nimbus as a procurement and governance capability, not as proof of fully sovereign cloud ownership.

exact_supported_claims: AI21 publishes the Jamba family of open foundation models.
The page describes self-hosted and cloud deployment options.
The current page includes Jamba2 model variants.
unsupported_or_overextended_claims: The product page alone does not prove a precise nationality or ownership distribution for the company.
Self-hosting does not eliminate dependence on imported accelerators, software dependencies or maintenance expertise.
audits.required_dataset_action: Retain AI21 as an Israel-based model capability. Add a separate corporate source before using domestically_owned as a strict ownership claim.

exact_supported_claims: Intel describes Israel as a key global manufacturing and R&D site.
Intel identifies Kiryat Gat as its most advanced manufacturing facility in Israel.
Intel identifies Haifa as a processor and AI development center and Petah Tikva as a communications and AI solutions development center.
limitations: The facilities are located and operated in Israel but remain part of a United States-headquartered corporate structure.
Local fabrication remains dependent on global semiconductor equipment, materials and corporate roadmaps.
audits.required_dataset_action: No material correction. Preserve foreign_owned_locally_operated and separate local strategic value from national ownership.

exact_supported_claims: NVIDIA operates a Tel Aviv research lab described as the NVIDIA Research Israel AI Lab.
The lab researches deep learning, computer vision, reinforcement learning, perception, action and reasoning.
limitations: A research lab is a talent and R&D capability, not domestic ownership of NVIDIA models, accelerators or manufacturing.
audits.required_dataset_action: No material correction. Keep the node in talent_research and foreign_owned_locally_operated.

corroborating_source.supported_claim: A Knesset committee discussed the government decision of 16 June 2026 and the national AI strategy, including the stated direction of access equivalent to 100,000 AI processors.

limitations: The Knesset press release is useful corroboration but is not a substitute for the full binding text of the government decision.
The current dataset must not rely on an unresolved URL as its only primary evidence.
audits.required_dataset_action: Locate a stable official decision page, downloadable official document or archived government copy before v0.4 release. Until then mark detailed Decision 4255 claims as source_pending rather than fully audited.

exact_supported_claims_in_current_datase: United States data centers consumed approximately 4.4 percent of United States electricity in 2023.
The cited projection range for 2028 is 6.7 percent to 12 percent.
audits.required_dataset_action: Reopen the linked report in the next audit batch, capture the exact table or passage and confirm forecast framing before v0.4 release.

next_actions: Replace or archive the official Government Decision 4255 source.
Add a corporate-registry or equivalent primary source for AI21 ownership classification.
Audit Israeli electricity-generation data and remove the 74 percent metric if the exact official source cannot be recovered.
Perform line-level audits for United States energy, TSMC Arizona, Intel United States manufacturing and Micron HBM claims.
Patch the canonical dataset only after the corrections are consolidated into a reproducible v0.4 build.
